title: State v. Doe
facts: Defendant seen near store at 10:03 PM
Store window found broken at 10:10 PM
jury_instructions: Presume innocence. Evaluate credibility of witnesses and reliability of forensic evidence.

evidence_items.content: Clerk testified she saw a man matching defendant's description outside the store.
Fingerprint on the broken window matches the defendant.
CCTV timeline showing a figure near the store entrance at 10:03 PM.
